description: Create an alert rule for the current user: an on-chain transfer alert (the default), a Hyperliquid or a Polymarket alert, chosen by `alert_type`. TRANSFER ('transfer'): fires when a transfer on ONE chain (eth, bsc, base or hyperevm) matches: token_symbol if given, min_value_usd if given, and, if `address` is given, that wallet on the side `address_role` says. `address` = ONE 20-byte EVM address ('0x' + 40 hex); ENS names, entity names and non-EVM addresses are refused. Without min_value_usd EVERY transfer touching the address matches (dust and unpriced tokens too); with min_value_usd or max_value_usd only transfers that already carry a USD value do. min_amount (needs token_symbol) is a floor in whole tokens, priced or not; set with a USD bound, both must hold. An alert with an `address` notifies on EVERY matching transfer: no cooldown, no daily cap. A token-wide alert (no address) sends one notification per cooldown_minutes for the newest match, at most 10 a day. HYPERLIQUID (perpetuals only; leave out chain, address, address_role and max_value_usd): hl_wallet = every fill of `wallet` (required), narrowed by `actions`, `token_symbol` (the coin) and min_value_usd; hl_cohort_fill = every fill by wallets in `pnl_cohorts` / `size_cohorts` (at least one cohort is REQUIRED, or it would match every large fill on Hyperliquid), REQUIRES min_value_usd >= 10000; hl_liquidation = every liquidation, optionally of one `wallet`, of cohorts, of one coin, above a min_value_usd floor; hl_cohort_bias = the cohort `index` of `token_symbol` (required) crossing `threshold` by `band`, filtered by `direction`; hl_liq_proximity = `wallet` (required) getting `threshold` of the way from entry to liquidation price; hl_wallet_orders = the orders of `wallet` (required) worth at least min_value_usd (size x price, default 10000, >= 1000) that are placed or gone (`events`), narrowed by `side` and `token_symbol`, from the 5-minute order-book snapshots, as one event per evaluator pass (about every 5 minutes) whose `orders` lists every one of them with its `action` (placed or gone; a gone one with its outcome filled, partially_filled or canceled) and the pass totals beside it (a pass of more than 200 orders comes as `parts` events of 200, each with its `part` and the same totals); private to the alert's owner. Fill and liquidation alerts notify on every event; a wallet alert once per coin, action and side of each evaluator pass (about every 10 s): the fills merged into one event, `fills` their count, min_value_usd applied to the merged total. Bias and proximity alerts notify once per crossing and re-arm after the value retreats by `band`. POLYMARKET (leave out chain, address, address_role, max_value_usd and token_symbol): pm_wallet_trade = every trade of the proxy `wallet` (required), optionally in one `condition_id` and above min_value_usd; pm_market_trade = every trade in `condition_id` (required) at or above min_value_usd (REQUIRED, >= 1000); pm_price_move = a move of 0.05 or more within 5 minutes in the price of the market's first outcome (Yes), filtered by `direction`; pm_resolution = the market resolved. Each notifies on every event. cooldown_minutes does not apply to Hyperliquid or Polymarket alerts. They are delivered by a webhook channel (register one with alerts_register_webhook) and/or e-mail, or only read with alerts_events (channels left empty); `channels` = ['email'] mails the account address: one mail per evaluator pass listing its events, and (but for hl_wallet) none after the alert's 10th event of the UTC day. `label` is the user-visible name. `channels` = ['email'], ['webhook'] or both (Discord is temporarily off and is refused). One address and one chain per transfer alert: create several alerts to watch more. Returns the new alert row including its id, its `policy` and, for a Hyperliquid or Polymarket alert, an `hl` or `pm` object.

actions.description: hl_wallet only: which fills notify. Default: open, close, flip, increase ('add' is accepted for increase); reduce is opt-in.

address.description: Transfer alerts only: wallet to watch, one 0x + 40-hex EVM address. Matches transfers (native or token) the address sent or received on `chain`, per address_role.

address_role.description: Transfer alerts only: any = sent or received (default), from = only transfers the address sent, to = only transfers it received. Needs `address`.

alert_type.description: transfer (default), a Hyperliquid type (hl_wallet, hl_cohort_fill, hl_liquidation, hl_cohort_bias, hl_liq_proximity, hl_wallet_orders) or a Polymarket type (pm_wallet_trade, pm_market_trade, pm_price_move, pm_resolution). Fixed once created.

band.description: hl_cohort_bias and hl_liq_proximity: hysteresis, greater than 0 (default 0.1). A bias alert fires when the index reaches threshold + band (up) or threshold - band (down); a proximity alert fires when the ratio reaches threshold and re-arms below threshold - band.

chain.description: Transfer alerts only: the chain to watch (single value). Default: eth. Ask the user to create two alerts if they want both chains. Leave out for Hyperliquid alerts.

channels.description: Which kinds of the user's enabled channels to notify. email: any alert (a Hyperliquid or Polymarket alert mails the account address). webhook: any alert (register one with alerts_register_webhook; asking for a Hyperliquid or Polymarket alert's webhook the user has not registered is an error). Discord is temporarily off and is refused, as is any other type. A kind the user has no enabled channel of is dropped from a transfer alert, and a transfer alert left with no channel e-mails the account address: call alerts_list_channels to see what is set up. Whatever the channels, every match is recorded as an event in the feed read with alerts_events (kept 15 days), so leave channels empty for a Hyperliquid or Polymarket alert you will only read there.

condition_id.description: Polymarket only: the market, its 0x + 64-hex condition id. Required for pm_market_trade, pm_price_move and pm_resolution; optional for pm_wallet_trade (one market of that wallet).

cooldown_minutes.description: Token-wide transfer alerts (no address): minimum gap between notifications. Default 60. Address alerts and Hyperliquid and Polymarket alerts notify on every event and ignore it.

direction.description: hl_cohort_bias: which crossings notify. pm_price_move: which moves of the market's first outcome (Yes on a yes/no market) notify. Default both.

events.description: hl_wallet_orders only: placed = a new order appeared in the book, gone = an order left it (its outcome filled, partially_filled or canceled comes from the order's own fills). Default both. Each check's orders arrive together, as one event.

index.description: hl_cohort_bias only, required: the index watched for token_symbol. smi = long share of smart wallets minus long share of rekt wallets; wsi = long share of whales minus long share of shrimp; smart_bias / whale_bias = (long - short) / (long + short) of that cohort; smi_wsi_gap = smi - wsi. Ratios run -1..1 (smi_wsi_gap -2..2).

label.description: Name for this alert (e.g. 'Big USDC moves')

max_value_usd.description: Transfer alerts only: an upper bound on the transfer's USD value. A transfer worth more than this does not notify (one worth exactly this does). Like min_value_usd it needs a transfer that already carries a USD value, so an unpriced transfer never matches a rule with a bound. Keep it at or above min_value_usd: a rule whose minimum is above its maximum never fires.

min_amount.description: Transfer alerts only, with token_symbol: alert when the transfer moves at least this many WHOLE tokens (1000000 USDT, 0.5 ETH), whether or not it carries a USD value. With min_value_usd or max_value_usd as well, both must hold. A token whose decimals are unknown never matches it.

min_value_usd.description: Transfer: alert when transfer USD value >= this. Hyperliquid: a floor on the fill or liquidation size in USD (hl_wallet, hl_liquidation); required and >= 10000 for hl_cohort_fill; the order's size x price for hl_wallet_orders (>= 1000, default 10000); not used by hl_cohort_bias or hl_liq_proximity. Polymarket: a floor on the trade's USD (size x price) for pm_wallet_trade; required and >= 1000 for pm_market_trade.

pnl_cohorts.description: hl_cohort_fill and hl_liquidation: only wallets in these realised-PnL cohorts (the ladder runs from '3x smart' = top 1% to '3x rekt' = bottom 5%). hl_cohort_fill REQUIRES at least one PnL or size cohort; for hl_liquidation empty = any cohort.

side.description: hl_wallet_orders only: only buy or only sell orders. Leave out for both.

size_cohorts.description: hl_cohort_fill and hl_liquidation: only wallets in these account-size cohorts (the ladder runs from '4x whale' = $10M+ to 'shrimp' = under $1k). hl_cohort_fill REQUIRES at least one PnL or size cohort; for hl_liquidation empty = any size.

threshold.description: hl_cohort_bias: the index level to cross (default 0). hl_liq_proximity: the share of the way from entry price to liquidation price, strictly between 0 and 1 (default 0.8).

token_symbol.description: Transfer: token ticker in UPPERCASE (e.g. USDC, ETH, PEPE). Hyperliquid: the perp coin as Hyperliquid names it (BTC, kPEPE, xyz:CL); required for hl_cohort_bias, optional for the rest (omit = every coin).

wallet.description: One 0x + 40-hex address. Hyperliquid: the account to watch, required for hl_wallet, hl_wallet_orders and hl_liq_proximity, optional for hl_liquidation. Polymarket: the proxy wallet (the address of its vike.io/polymarket/wallet page and of polymarket_tape rows), required for pm_wallet_trade.
